title: Dishwasher magnetic sign CLEAN/DIRTY
author: user_986654475
description:
Found this model on my phone and it was all in one colour so i decided to make it printable with three colours for anyone else who wants to print this. It uses 3x8mm magnets with 2mm thickness but in my case required a bit of sanding to fit the magnets in.

kitchen sign clean dirty magnetic dishwasher magnet

storage.note: 3MF files are stored as .3mf.xz to stay under GitHub's 100MB limit. Decompress with `xz -d -k <file>` before use; SHA-256 is computed on the compressed file.
